review_note: 2026-10-11: templateCentral 5.15 to 6.0.1 review. Adopted the hook fixes that apply to a husky, Supabase repo (project-anchored hook commands with timeouts, clean-tree Stop skip, additionalContext typecheck feedback, the Skill matcher, the per-segment block-no-verify parser, protect-files path resolution, a verifier that fails on an unreadable manifest, a wider commit-msg gate) and removed post-tool-failure.sh. Not adopted: exec-form hooks (a bare bash resolved without a shell on Windows can be the WSL launcher), the 300s Stop timeout (this suite needs 1200s), the gitleaks command and allowlist syntax changes (untestable here), lefthook, ESLint 10, pnpm 12. Full reasoning is in the AGENTS.md entry of the same date. Hashes below were recomputed from the committed blobs and written through the ask-gated Edit tool, with the owner approving, in place of a regen-harness.sh run. 2026-08-15: templateCentral 5.14→5.15 sweep (Phase-5 re-sync, per qkit's own hash-baseline model — no .harness-base 3-way-merge machinery exists here, see the 2026-07-16 entry below; re-sync means comparing current content against harness-kit.md's canonical logic and adopting only genuinely-applicable deltas). Adopted: (1) protect-files.sh was missing the ask-gate case for .claude/comment-hygiene-patterns.txt despite it being a verify-harness.sh-tracked enforcement file — added, origin_hash below updated to match. (2) AGENTS.md's AI Harness section repeated the stale claim "PostCompact stdout is ignored, cannot inject context" — 5.15.0's own audit found this inaccurate (PostCompact's stdout IS injected as context after compaction) and fixed it in every scaffolded AGENTS.md template; corrected the wording here too. Investigated and NOT adopted: the CHANGELOG's `check_hook_command_uses_args_array` finding, which shows `"command": ["bash", ".claude/hooks/x.sh"]` (array form) as the canonical hook-command shape — attempting that exact syntax against this installed Claude Code version's live settings schema produced a validation error (`command` must be a string; true no-shell exec form is a separate `command`+`args` pair). Not applying the plugin doc's literal (and here, invalid) syntax; the current shell-string form already works correctly and the shell-quoting risk it's meant to avoid doesn't manifest in this repo (no spaces/quotes/backticks in any hook path). sonarjs.configs.recommended rollout, the CSP dev-mode X-Frame-Options/frame-ancestors fix, the next/eslint-config-next 16.2.12 bump, and the paykit/client.ts path-encoding fix (all also new in the 5.14→5.15 delta) were each shipped as their own separate, focused PR rather than folded into this harness commit — see this repo's PR history around 2026-08-15. Reviewed 5.0→5.7 delta; adopted build-artefact Read-denies. Deliberately NOT adopted (Supabase-variant divergence): pino route-logging enforcement (pino removed as unused; API logs via console.error), lefthook (uses husky/lint-staged), better-auth/Drizzle add-skills, tc CI/harness-verifier layer (has bespoke CI + no .harness-base). migrate Phase-5 re-sync N/A: no .harness-base merge base (seeded pre-5.3). 2026-07-10: cherry-picked the 5.8 hard comment gate (no-inline-comments error + sonarjs/no-commented-code) independent of a full 5.7→5.9 re-review; templatecentral_version left at 5.7.0 since the rest of that delta hasn't been audited. 2026-07-14: ran templatecentral:add (documentation) for 5.10's per-folder README governance — adoWiki defaulted false (GitHub-only repo, no Azure DevOps signal). 2026-07-16: drift-check against plugin 5.11.0 (project pinned 5.7.0) — reviewed the full 5.8-5.11 changelog; almost all of it is lefthook/CI-action-pinning/NestJS/FastAPI/OpenCode-adapter churn that doesn't apply to qkit's bespoke-CI, husky, Supabase-only setup. Two things did: (1) this project's per-folder READMEs already write real per-file content, not a filename-only manifest, matching 5.11's richReadme opt-in — recorded as richReadme:true. (2) readme-freshness here is a local pre-commit nudge only (scripts/check-readme-freshness.mjs, never blocks); 5.10 additionally seeds a CI job that hard-fails a PR with an unstaged README — deliberately not adopted, no CI-blocking doc gate exists yet. templatecentral_version left at 5.7.0 — most of the 5.8-5.11 delta is inapplicable, not yet fully re-audited. 2026-07-24: lefthook migration — the project owner overrode the 2026-06-05/07-16 husky decision to bring qkit's git-hook architecture in line with loopkit/stockkit/paykit/merqo. Replaced husky+lint-staged with lefthook (`lefthook.yml`, `.lefthook/`), replaced scripts/check-readme-freshness.mjs with .lefthook/readme-coupling.sh (same non-blocking nudge, now a lefthook pre-commit command), and split .claude/settings.json's inline `node -e` one-liner hooks into standalone .claude/hooks/*.sh|.cjs script files (loopkit's reference implementation). Net-new: .gitleaks.toml, .claude/verify-harness.sh (integrity sensor, wired into lefthook pre-push and left for CI to adopt later), .claude/regen-harness.sh (human-run-only baseline rewrite), and a SubagentStop hook (qkit had none before). templatecentral_version bumped 5.7.0 → 5.11.0: the 5.8-5.11 feature deltas (comment gate, README governance/richReadme, unused-vars gate) were already substantively reviewed in the entries above, so this bump reflects that this migration closes the one remaining architectural gap — the git-hook layer itself — rather than a fresh, unreviewed version jump. This also folds in the security hardening loopkit's hook scripts carry that qkit's old inline one-liners lacked: the LEFTHOOK=0/LEFTHOOK_EXCLUDE/core.hooksPath= bypass block, protected-branch/force-push/guard-file-checkout guards, a broadened --no-verify regex, an .env* catchall deny (previously only the specific .env.<env> variants), and OWASP LLM02 credential-leak detection in the prompt guard. seeded_files below now covers the full lefthook + hook-script-file set; `.claude/hooks/verify.sh` (the pre-existing manual build+check+test gate) is unchanged and kept. 2026-08-01: git hooks migrated lefthook -> husky (Windows Smart App Control blocks lefthook.exe's unsigned binary; a cross-repo decision spanning qkit/loopkit/stockkit/paykit/merqo, not qkit-local; see the workspace-level design doc at ../docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-01-lefthook-to-husky-migration-design.md, outside this repo's own git tree). 2026-08-05: templateCentral 5.11→5.14 sweep. (1) Version-marker drift fix: AGENTS.md's header comment had been left at 5.7.0 since the 2026-07-10 comment-gate cherry-pick even though this file's templatecentral_version was bumped to 5.11.0 on 2026-07-24 — bumped both to 5.14.0 together so they can't silently diverge again. (2) Fixed a .claude/settings.json permissions.deny bug: Read(**/.env.*) glob-matched .env.example (the committed template protect-files.sh explicitly keeps editable), making it unreadable via the Read/Bash-cat tools; replaced with the explicit nested-path variant list (**/.env, **/.env.local, **/.env.*.local, **/.env.development, **/.env.production, **/.env.staging, **/.env.test) mirroring the root-level entries already present. (3) Ported the 5.13 comment-hygiene mechanical-enforcement layer, adapted from the plugin's lefthook reference to this repo's husky pre-commit lib convention: new .claude/hooks/post-edit-comment-check.sh (PostToolUse, feedback-only via additionalContext), new .claude/comment-hygiene-patterns.txt (canonical pattern source for all three surfaces), a new warn-only .husky/lib/comment-hygiene.sh wired into .husky/lib/pre-commit.sh, and a hard comment-hygiene CI job in .github/workflows/ci.yml scoped to added lines only (skip-comment-check label bypass) — additive to, not a replacement of, the existing 5.8 no-inline-comments/sonarjs/no-commented-code ESLint gate. verify-harness.sh's guard regex now also covers comment-hygiene-patterns.txt. Did not adopt 5.10's CI-blocking readme-freshness gate or 5.11's other lefthook/CI-pinning churn — out of scope for this sweep and previously reviewed as inapplicable (see 2026-07-16 entry above); qkit's bespoke-CI/husky/Supabase-only posture is unchanged.
